import cv2
import numpy as np

def get_ground_pos(x_pix, y_pix, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    Z_cam = 396.8 / (y_pix - 256)
    X_cam = (x_pix - 256) * 1.55 / (y_pix - 256)
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    # camera forward is [sin(theta), cos(theta)] in world (x, y)
    # camera right is [cos(theta), -sin(theta)] in world (x, y)
    world_x = cam_x + Z_cam * np.sin(theta) + X_cam * np.cos(theta)
    world_y = cam_y + Z_cam * np.cos(theta) - X_cam * np.sin(theta)
    return world_x, world_y, Z_cam

# Let's inspect objects in various images
# 1. Potted plant:
img7 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0007.png')
# in obs_0007, pot base is near x=340..370, y=380..410
mask7 = (img7[:,:,2] > 120) & (img7[:,:,0] < 50)
y7, x7 = np.where(mask7)
print('Plant pot in obs_0007: x=[', x7.min(), x7.max(), '] y=[', y7.min(), y7.max(), ']')
# In obs_0007: cam=(0,0), heading=270 deg
# The base of the cylinder sits on ground. Ground contact center:
base_x7 = (x7.min() + x7.max()) / 2
base_y7 = y7.max()
wx, wy, z = get_ground_pos(base_x7, base_y7, 0, 0, 270)
print(f'Plant from obs_0007: x={wx:.2f}, y={wy:.2f}, dist={z:.2f}')

img8 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0008.png')
mask8 = (img8[:,:,2] > 120) & (img8[:,:,0] < 50)
y8, x8 = np.where(mask8)
base_x8 = (x8.min() + x8.max()) / 2
base_y8 = y8.max()
wx8, wy8, z8 = get_ground_pos(base_x8, base_y8, 0, 0, 315)
print(f'Plant from obs_0008: x={wx8:.2f}, y={wy8:.2f}, dist={z8:.2f}')
"", "description": "Calculate plant position from obs_0007 and obs_0008"}

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0012.png')

        mean_x = np.mean([p[1] for p in sub if p[0] == max_y])

"", "description": "Find legs below 460 in obs_0012"}

with open("/work/history.jsonl") as f:
